summary: crypto-validate-lib ships base64-decoded payload evaluated at load time
details: index.js line 62 constructs a runtime string via Buffer.from(<data>, 'base64').toString('utf8'), a common obfuscation technique used to hide an embedded payload from static inspection. The package presents itself as a crypto validation library but the load-time base64 decoding path indicates hidden executable content rather than legitimate validation logic. The concealed nature of the payload combined with the package's short lifespan and lack of a documented purpose for runtime base64 decoding is consistent with credential/data exfiltration or dropper behavior triggered on require.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
